UAV integration A B S T R A C T As an emerging field of aerial robotics, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have gained significant research
interest within the wireless networking research community. As soon as national legislations allow UAVs
to fly autonomously, we will see swarms of UAV populating the sky of our smart cities to accomplish
different missions: parcel delivery, infrastructure monitoring, event filming
